clause: Non-destructive re-editability + explicit destructive apply-in-place duality mechanism [STU-RAS-008]

scope.summary: Implement the mechanism guaranteeing that adjustment, live-filter, fill, and mask layers persist their parameters as structured StudioLayer payload and are re-editable at any time, never baked into pixels until an explicit rasterize/merge command. Provide the shared apply-in-place (destructive) command primitive that every non-destructive feature can invoke, which bakes to pixels and emits a distinct StudioHistoryEntry separate from the non-destructive edit. Backend mechanism consumed by all adjustment/filter/fill/mask MTs.
acceptance_criteria: parameters persist re-editably until explicit rasterize/merge
apply-in-place available for every non-destructive feature and emits a distinct history entry
expected_tests: live: adjustment params re-editable after reopen; apply-in-place bakes to pixels and emits a distinct history entry
test: no implicit baking occurs on parameter change; both edit forms round-trip through history

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Non-destructive edits silently bake; operators lose re-editability; history conflates destructive/non-destructive ops.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
